scope: Environmental scenery in the six supported games

classic.notes: The imported Emerald voxel_building_specs is not the active Classic model list. The tree renderer has no FireRed room-renderer path.

firered.notes: Room shapes and their packed texture must be generated together. Keep original row fields and UVs unless rebuilding the matching recipe.

frlg.notes: Shares FireRed renderer structure, but rebuilding from the FRLG+ ROM produces different room rows and texture slots. Never copy generated tables by game-name similarity.

letsgo.notes: Export changes as patches to pokedaisy-build; do not push the modified upstream checkout.

radical.notes: Gate by exact ROM CRC and primary/secondary tileset. Numeric tile IDs alone are not asset identities.

unbound.notes: Green and snow tilesets are separate profiles. Preserve water and cliff backgrounds under replacement foliage.
